title: Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences BS
notes:
General Guidelines
- All technical courses taken in satisfaction of major requirements must be taken for a letter grade.
- No more than one upper division course may be used to simultaneously fulfill requirements for a student’s major and minor programs.
- A minimum overall grade point average (GPA) of 2.0 is required for all work undertaken at UC Berkeley.
- A minimum GPA of 2.0 is required for all technical courses taken in satisfaction of major requirements.

requirements.title: Physics
requirements.notes: Students who take PHYSICS 5A to satisfy the Physics A requirement must take PHYSICS 5B and PHYSICS 5BL to complete the Physics B requirement.

requirements.title: EECS Upper Division Requirement
requirements.notes: The full text is on the catalog page.

rule.text:
Earn at least 20 units from the following:
- EECS courses numbered 100-C191B
- ELENG courses numbered 100-194
- COMPSCI courses numbered 100-194, excluding COMPSCI 194 (Section 100)
- COMPSCI 270, C280, 285, 288, 294 (Section 84: Interactive Device Design), 294 (Section 129: Designing, Visualizing and Understanding Deep Neural Networks); ELENG 229A
- INFO 153A, 159, 213
- Courses cross-listed with the above listings
Of the 20 units required, at least one course needs to be from this list:
- ELENG 113B, C128, 130, 140, 143, 192 … (see the catalog for the rest)

The 40 units include EECS lower division courses, with the exception of COMPSCI 70, as well as 20 units of EECS Upper Division Technical Electives.
If you have previously taken the articulated version of a UC Berkeley course that you are currently enrolled in, the UC Berkeley course will be used to satisfy the requirement once it is graded.

requirements.title: Natural Science Elective
requirements.notes: The full text is on the catalog page.

rule.text:
Complete ANY of the following courses:
- ASTRON 7A, 7B, 7AB (will only count if PHYSICS 7A and 7B are completed first)
- BIOLOGY 1A and 1AL (must take both), 1B;
- CHEM 1A and 1AL (must take both), 1B, 3A and 3AL (must take both), 3B and 3BL (must take both), 4A, 4B
- EECS C191A, C191B
- MCELLBI 32 and 32L (must take both)
- PHYSICS 7C, 5C and 5CL (must take both)
- Any 3+ unit ASTRON 100-196 level course
- Any 3+ unit CHEM 101-196 level course, excluding 100, 149, 192
- Any 3+ unit INTEGBI 100-196 level course, excluding 101, C105, 191
- Any 3+ unit MCELLBI 100-196 level course … (see the catalog for the rest)

requirements.title: Ethics
requirements.notes: Students must complete one course, which may be taken for a letter grade or pass/no pass.
